hero.h1: The single access point to the region's regulatory information
hero.lead: The NA-MRH Digital Collaboration Platform brings together the National Regulatory Authorities of North Africa: institutional communication, secure collaboration and regulatory knowledge management.

homeSections.missionH: A platform built phase by phase
homeSections.missionP: Designed as a progressive, modular build, the platform delivers a complete, usable tool at the end of every three-month phase — without waiting for the full project to be completed.
homeSections.twgP: Each TWG is co-led by two member countries and prioritised into waves according to its maturity.

governance.p: The Secretariat is hosted by Tunisia; North Africa has no standing REC Secretariat yet.
governance.steeringD: Directors General of the National Regulatory Authorities — validates strategy, terms of reference and roadmaps.
governance.secretariatD: Hosted by Tunisia (ANMPS) · Coordinator: Dr Mariam Aounallah · Planning, reporting, partner liaison.
governance.twgLevelD: Two co-leads per group · guidelines, SOPs, joint activities.
governance.partnersP: AUDA-NEPAD · African Medicines Agency (AMA) · WHO · Swissmedic · World Bank · AfDB

newsPage.p: Tracking Secretariat, working-group and partner activities.

contactPage.p: The NA-MRH Secretariat, hosted by Tunisia, coordinates exchanges with the member countries and partners.
contactPage.secP: Coordinator: Dr Mariam Aounallah — hosted by ANMPS, Tunisia.
contactPage.nraT: Contacts of the National Regulatory Authorities

complaintsPage.p: Not satisfied with a Secretariat service? Let us know: every complaint is reviewed and tracked through to resolution.
complaintsPage.confirmP: Your complaint has been forwarded to the NA-MRH Secretariat, which will follow up after review.
complaintsPage.errorSent: Something went wrong. Please try again.

comingSoon.p: This section is on the roadmap and will be delivered in a forthcoming rollout step.
comingSoon.notice: The platform is built phase by phase: each section goes live once it is complete and verified, rather than half-finished.

membersPage.h: Member States and National Regulatory Authorities
membersPage.p: Each country manages its own internal users and contributes to the regional document repository within a shared framework.

libraryPage.p: Deposit, classification and search of regulatory documents produced by the Secretariat and the working groups.
libraryPage.notice: Full document access requires authentication through the secure RIMS Portal.

twgsPage.p: Prioritised into three waves on 18 August 2026 — Secretariat support follows the ranking.

footer.aboutP: North African Medicines Regulatory Harmonization Initiative — pharmaceutical regulatory convergence in North Africa, aligned with the priorities of the African Medicines Agency (AMA) and AUDA-NEPAD.
